Title: Peace Agreement Signatory Dashboard
Summary: A network dashboard template mapping actors' involvement in peace and transition processes, using the PA-X and PAA-X (Peace Agreement Actor) datasets.
Contributors: Jinrui Wang; Niamh Henry; Benjamin Bach; Sanja Badanjak; Christine Bell

Title: Implementation Narratives Tracker
Summary: A dashboard tracking implementation records against peace agreement provisions by topic, using PA-X and Implementation Reports data.
Contributors: Roy Gardner; Jinrui Wang; Niamh Henry

Title: PA-X Local Agreements Map
Summary: A map of agreements addressing local issues, local actors, and local/communal violent conflict, using the PA-X Local dataset.

Title: Sudan Mediation Analysis
Summary: A dashboard analysing Sudan and South Sudan mediation processes, using pilot data from GLO-PAD.
Contributors: Tomas Vancisin; Mateja Peter; Niamh Henry

Title: Third Party in Peace Agreements Storytelling
Summary: A scrollytelling piece tracing practical third-party involvement in peace processes over time, stage, and location, using the PAA-X and PA-X datasets.
Contributors: Tomas Vancisin; Mateja Peter; Niamh Henry; Sanja Badanjak

Title: PA-X Tracker Globe
Summary: An interactive globe giving a world snapshot of ongoing peace processes and conflict levels, using PA-X, UCDP, and ACLED data.

Title: Peace Agreement Signatories Network Analysis
Summary: A network-analysis dashboard examining the presence or absence of signatories across peace agreements, using the PAA-X dataset.
Contributors: Roy Gardner; Niamh Henry; Sanja Badanjak

Title: Semantic Mapping: Peace Agreements — Constitutions
Summary: A timeline and bar-chart analysis of how peace agreements influence subsequent constitutions, using semantic mapping of similar provisions, drawing on PA-X agreement data.

Title: Ukraine Conflict Map
Summary: An interactive map layering conflict dynamics of the Russia-Ukraine war — violence events, conflict deaths, ethnic composition, power infrastructure, and humanitarian corridors — using data from ACLED, UCDP, EPR, the Global Power Plant Database, and PeaceRep/partner humanitarian-corridor research.
Datasets: ACLED; UCDP; EPR; Power Plants; Humanitarian Corridors
Contributors: Sarah Schöttler; Benjamin Bach; Niamh Henry

Title: Timelines of Institutional Change
Summary: Interactive timelines of formal institutional change in a selected country — peace and local agreements, constitutional events, amnesties, elections, and coups — using PA-X, Colpus, Constitute, NELDA, and Amnesties data.
Contributors: Niamh Henry; Sanja Badanjak; Christine Bell

Title: Process Overview Dashboard
Summary: A dashboard giving a high-level snapshot of PA-X process data — filterable by country, process, or agreement type — covering agreement counts, types, negotiation stage, a timeline, and key issues addressed.
Contributors: Niamh Henry; Sanja Badanjak; Christine Bell

Title: Peace Impacts Dashboard(s)
Summary: A dashboard tracking the impacts of peace processes on conflict, security, political, economic, and humanitarian indicators in a country, using PA-X data.
Contributors: Niamh Henry; Sanja Badanjak; Christine Bell

Title: Agreement - Actor Networks Country Profiles
Summary: An interactive network of agreement-actor relationships, where actors and agreements are linked by party or third-party signatory status, with click-through detail on each node, using the PAA-X dataset.

Title: South Sudan Perceptions of Peace Survey
Summary: A dashboard presenting findings from a longitudinal survey on perceptions of peace in South Sudan, by PeaceRep, Detcro, USIP and partners, using the SSD Surveys dataset.

Title: Children and Youth in Peace Agreements
Summary: A dashboard coding references to children and/or youth across 348 peace agreements (1990-2022) into topics such as child soldiers, children's rights, transitional justice, third-party actors, and inclusion/protection provisions, using PA-X data.

Title: Ukraine-Russia Conflict: Dialogues, Proposals and Issues
Summary: A network mapping peace proposals and agreements in Russia's war against Ukraine — what topics they address, where topics overlap, and who has signed — drawing on Cindy Wittke's 'Islands of Civility' research compilation rather than a registered dataset.

Title: Practical Third Parties Dashboard
Summary: A dashboard exploring practical/de-facto third-party involvement in peace processes by actor or process, using a subset of the PAA-X dataset.

Title: Dialogue mapping experiments
Summary: An interactive vis exploring dialogue-mapping methods, last trialled on Myanmar-related questions; it was an experiment with country specific outputs.
Contributors: Niamh Henry; Robert Wilson; Sanja Badanjak

Title: Hierarchy & Continuity in Key Issues
Summary: A dashboard showing the diversity of peace agreements over time, revealing how coverage of key issues has evolved, using PA-X data.

Title: Back and Forth in Peace Negotiations
Summary: A bespoke timeline contrasting the ideal peace-process sequence with the messy reality of the negotiation stages agreements actually pass through, using PA-X data.
Contributors: Tobias Kauer; Benjamin Bach; Tomas Vancisin

Title: Map Visualising Peace Agreements in Time and Space
Summary: A map-and-timeline dashboard of peace agreements and the issues they address, using PA-X data.
Contributors: Lucy Havens; Sarah Schöttler; Benjamin Bach; Mengting Bao

Title: Peace Agreement Sequence Comparison across Countries
Summary: A comparison timeline tool of how peace agreement sequences unfold over time across case countries, using PA-X data, with links to full agreement texts.
Contributors: Lucy Havens; Sarah Schöttler; Benjamin Bach

Title: PA-X Key Themes through Interactive Infographics
Summary: An infographic series highlighting key themes in PA-X peace agreement data.

Title: Tile Grid Map of Peace Issues
Summary: A tile grid map showing the composition of peace agreements across key issues, agreement types, and negotiation stages, using PA-X data.

Title: Peace Agreement Content Alluvial
Summary: An alluvial diagram tracking 293 issue and sub-issue categories mentioned across the PA-X collection of peace agreements.

Title: Yemen Timeline
Summary: A beeswarm timeline of conflict events and peace/transition documents in Yemen since 1990, connecting national and local peace initiatives, in Arabic and English, using PA-X data.
Contributors: Tobias Kauer; Benjamin Bach; Robert Wilson; Raiman Al-Hamdani

Title: Five Ways Peace Process can Support Inclusion More Effectively
Summary: An illustrated comic explaining five ways peace processes can support inclusion more effectively.

Title: Call for Peace Illustrations
Summary: A set of illustrations depicting how conflict impacts children's growth, women's lives, and daily travel.

Title: PA-X Gender Key Insights Story
Summary: A scrollytelling story of key insights on gender provisions in peace agreements — geography, timeline, topic clustering, and trends over time — using PA-X and PA-X Gender data.

Title: Yemen Map
Summary: A dashboard mapping and timelining Yemen peace agreements by location and date, using the PA-X Peace Agreements Database.
Contributors: Sarah Schöttler; Lucy Havens; Mengting Bao

Title: Pieces of Peace: Women and Gender in Peace Processes
Summary: A data physicalisation artwork representing women and gender in peace processes, translating PA-X and PA-X Gender data into physical pieces.
Contributors: Jenny Long; Jinrui Wang; Tomas Vancisin; Laura Wise; Niamh Henry

Title: PA-X Chart Explorer
Summary: A dashboard exploring PA-X and PAA-X data through stage-comparison bar charts, actor and topic geo-scatter maps, and an actor co-occurrence UpSet plot.

Title: PeaceRep Style Guide
Summary: A logo and brand-asset showcase for PeaceRep — not a research data visualisation — listing downloadable PeaceRep logo variants.

Title: Global PeaceHub - Mediation Event and Negotiators Database
Summary: An interactive report of mediation data of conflicts by external third parties — a mediator network, map, and heatmap against conflict activity — using MEND mediation-event data and UCDP.

Title: PA-X Tracker
Summary: The PA-X Tracker is an interactive platform that consolidates a range of widely used data sources through PeaceTech tools that provide snap-shot overviews and insights into the dynamic nature of peace and transition processes.

Title: Provenance of Peacebuilding
Summary: A provenance-tree visualisation making visible the processes and people involved in peacebuilding, using PA-X data.
Contributors: Tomas Vancisin; Niamh Henry; Uta Hinrichs; Jinrui Wang; Benjamin Bach

Title: South Sudan Peace Perceptions Map
Summary: A map of survey results on South Sudanese people's perceptions of peace, using the SSD Surveys dataset.
Contributors: Tomas Vancisin; Niamh Henry; Jan Pospisil
